annotation.title_clean: Arrêté numéro 2018-16 du ministre des Transports, de la Mobilité durable et de l'Électrification des transports — Projet-pilote relatif aux autobus et aux minibus autonomes
annotation.title_en: Order No. 2018-16 of the Minister of Transport — Pilot Project on Autonomous Buses and Minibuses
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministre des Transports, de la Mobilité durable et de l'Électrification des transports (Québec)
annotation.summary_en: Quebec ministerial order establishing a five-year pilot project allowing experimentation with autonomous buses and minibuses (SAE J3016 level 3-5) on public roads. It sets eligibility, registration, driver training, incident reporting, $1M minimum liability insurance, manufacturer reimbursement of insurer indemnities, and authorizes a Keolis/Navya shuttle trial in Candiac.
key_provisions_or_claims: Pilot project authorizes testing autonomous buses/minibuses (SAE J3016 level 4-5, or 3 if not sold in Canada) for up to five years.
Promoters must submit project applications, register vehicles, and train drivers who must be able to take over immediately.
Mandatory immediate reporting of accidents, safety events and defects; annual experimentation reports including disengagements.
Minimum liability insurance of $1,000,000; manufacturer/distributor must reimburse the Société de l'assurance automobile and post a bond.
Authorizes Keolis Canada Innovation to operate a Navya Autonom Shuttle in Candiac, with no passengers for the first two weeks.
